booking_values.name: booking_values
booking_values.value: "app"."bookings"."code" ~ '^BK-[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{3}$' AND length(trim("app"."bookings"."complaint")) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND "app"."bookings"."estimated_total" >= 0 AND "app"."bookings"."estimated_minutes" > 0 AND "app"."bookings"."version" > 0

booking_reservation_status.name: booking_reservation_status
booking_reservation_status.value: "app"."bookings"."reservation_status" IN ('active','cancelled') AND ("app"."bookings"."reservation_status" <> 'cancelled' OR ("app"."bookings"."status" = 'confirmed' AND "app"."bookings"."checked_in_at" IS NULL))

invoice_line_values.name: invoice_line_values
invoice_line_values.value: "app"."invoice_lines"."position" BETWEEN 0 AND 99 AND "app"."invoice_lines"."kind" IN ('service','part') AND length(trim("app"."invoice_lines"."description")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "app"."invoice_lines"."quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 999 AND "app"."invoice_lines"."unit_price">=0 AND "app"."invoice_lines"."quantity"::bigint*"app"."invoice_lines"."unit_price"<=2147483647

invoice_issuance.name: invoice_issuance
invoice_issuance.value: "app"."invoices"."status" IN ('pending','ready','failed') AND "app"."invoices"."attempts">=0 AND ("app"."invoices"."status"<>'ready' OR ("app"."invoices"."file_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."invoices"."file_size">0 AND "app"."invoices"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL))

notification_target.name: notification_target
notification_target.value: (("app"."notifications"."kind" = 'otp' AND "app"."notifications"."challenge_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."notifications"."booking_id" IS NULL AND "app"."notifications"."booking_version" IS NULL AND "app"."notifications"."scheduled_at" IS NULL) OR ("app"."notifications"."kind" IN ('confirmation','reminder','received','in_progress','completed') AND "app"."notifications"."challenge_id" IS NULL AND "app"."notifications"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."notifications"."booking_version" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."notifications"."booking_version" > 0 AND "app"."notifications"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL)) AND "app"."notifications"."invoice_id" IS NULL AND "app"."notifications"."request_key" IS NULL AND "app"."notifications"."requested_by" IS NULL AND "app"."notifications"."recipient_phone" IS NULL OR ("app"."notifications"."kind"='invoice' AND "app"."notifications"."invoice_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."notifications"."request_key" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."notifications"."requested_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."notifications"."recipient_phone" ~ '^[+]628[0-9]{8,11}$' AND "app"."notifications"."recipient_phone" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."notifications"."challenge_id" IS NULL AND "app"."notifications"."booking_id" IS NULL AND "app"."notifications"."booking_version" IS NULL AND "app"."notifications"."scheduled_at" IS NULL)

otp_values.name: otp_values
otp_values.value: "app"."otp_challenges"."purpose" IN ('login','contact') AND ("app"."otp_challenges"."purpose" = 'login' OR "app"."otp_challenges"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL) AND "app"."otp_challenges"."attempts" BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND "app"."otp_challenges"."expires_at" <= "app"."otp_challenges"."created_at" + interval '5 minutes'

payment_values.name: payment_values
payment_values.value: "app"."payments"."status"='paid' AND "app"."payments"."total" BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 AND "app"."payments"."received" >= "app"."payments"."total" AND "app"."payments"."change"="app"."payments"."received"-"app"."payments"."total" AND (("app"."payments"."method"='cash' AND "app"."payments"."reference"='') OR ("app"."payments"."method" IN ('qris','edc') AND "app"."payments"."received"="app"."payments"."total" AND length(trim("app"."payments"."reference")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100))

service_values.name: service_values
service_values.value: length(trim("app"."services"."name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "app"."services"."price" >= 0 AND "app"."services"."duration_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440

slot_capacity.name: slot_capacity
slot_capacity.value: "app"."slots"."reserved" >= 0 AND "app"."slots"."quota" >= "app"."slots"."reserved" AND "app"."slots"."quota" <= 1000 AND ("app"."slots"."quota_override" IS NULL OR "app"."slots"."quota_override" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000) AND ("app"."slots"."active" OR "app"."slots"."reserved" = 0)

vehicle_values.name: vehicle_values
vehicle_values.value: "app"."vehicles"."plate" ~ '^[A-Z]{1,2}[0-9]{1,4}[A-Z]{0,3}$' AND length(trim("app"."vehicles"."brand")) BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND length(trim("app"."vehicles"."model")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND "app"."vehicles"."year" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2200 AND "app"."vehicles"."version" > 0

work_order_line_values.name: work_order_line_values
work_order_line_values.value: "app"."work_order_lines"."position" BETWEEN 0 AND 99 AND "app"."work_order_lines"."kind" IN ('service','part') AND ("app"."work_order_lines"."kind"='service')=("app"."work_order_lines"."service_id" IS NOT NULL) AND length(trim("app"."work_order_lines"."description")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "app"."work_order_lines"."quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 999 AND "app"."work_order_lines"."unit_price" BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647 AND "app"."work_order_lines"."quantity"::bigint*"app"."work_order_lines"."unit_price" <= 2147483647

work_order_values.name: work_order_values
work_order_values.value: "app"."work_orders"."odometer" BETWEEN 0 AND 9999999 AND length(trim("app"."work_orders"."initial_condition")) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length("app"."work_orders"."pit") <= 60 AND length("app"."work_orders"."assignee") <= 100 AND "app"."work_orders"."version" > 0 AND "app"."work_orders"."origin" IN ('online','walk_in')
